title: Hearth community subclass
description: `data` mirrors the shape Hearth's Subclass Forge stores for homebrew subclasses (loadAiHomebrew entries with type 'subclass', injected into SUBCLASSES[klass][id] by injectHomebrewSubclassesIntoRegistry): { klass, id, name, desc, levelFeatures }.

id.description: snake_case registry key, conventionally the item id with - replaced by _

levelFeatures.description: Keyed by class level ("1" to "20"), each an array of { name, desc, effects? } features.

effects.description: Optional structured Forge effects (kind: 'active', 'resist', 'skill', 'speed', 'ac', 'rider', 'grant_spells', ...). Unknown kinds are ignored by Hearth.
